title.en: Define the task before choosing a tool
title.zh: 先定义任务，再选择工具

paragraphs.en: AI studies perception, learning, reasoning and decision-making. Face recognition compares photographs; water-demand forecasting predicts a number; game-playing selects an action. AI need not have a robot body. Ordinary automation and AI may coexist in one product: storing a photograph is different from recognizing a face.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能研究感知、学习、推理与决策：人脸识别比较照片，用水预测输出数值，下棋选择行动。AI不必有机器人机身。同一产品可以同时包含普通自动化与AI，保存照片不等于识别人脸。

paragraphs.en: Describe the input, intended output, operating conditions and success criterion. One leaf photo can support counting leaves, identifying a species or checking image sharpness. A working program can still answer the wrong question. For a music assistant, trace recording → transcription → interpreting song/request/context → search → playback. An upstream transcription error can cause a wrong song even when search itself is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 先明确输入、输出、使用条件与成功标准。同一张叶片照片可用于数叶子、辨认植物或检查清晰度。程序能运行，也可能回答了错误问题。音乐助手的过程是录音→转写→理解歌曲、要求与上下文→检索→播放。转写错误可传到后面，即使检索步骤本身没有错。

flow.en: Recording → speech recognition → request/context → song search → playback
flow.zh: 录音→语音识别→要求与上下文→歌曲检索→播放

title.en: Rules, training, inference and generalization

paragraphs.en: Explicit rules work well for a timer or a maximum-finding algorithm. Handwritten digits vary in angle, shape, blur and lighting, making exhaustive rules difficult. Machine learning uses data or experience to improve performance; expert systems can instead reason from domain rules without learning from a large sample.
paragraphs.zh: 明确规则适合计时器或找最大值。手写数字在角度、形状、模糊和光照上变化很多，难以逐一写全规则。机器学习利用数据或经验改善表现；专家系统也可以直接用领域规则推理，不一定从大量样本学习。

paragraphs.en: A parameter is an adjustable numerical value in a model. Training compares outputs with targets and changes parameters; inference uses current parameters on an input and ordinarily does not change them. A labeled digit image is a training sample. Repeatedly predicting a mistaken image will not necessarily fix the model. Generalization means succeeding on unseen cases, so evaluate held-out examples rather than just memorized training images. In logic, “inference” can instead mean deriving a conclusion from premises.
paragraphs.zh: 参数是模型中可调的数值。训练比较输出与目标并调整参数；推理用当前参数处理输入，通常不修改参数。带正确类别的数字图片是训练样本，重复识别错图未必会修正模型。泛化是做好未见过的情况，因此要用未参与训练的新样本评价，而非只看记住的训练图片。逻辑语境中的“推理”也可指从前提推出结论。

title.en: Same modality, different questions

paragraphs.en: Images are grids of pixels; color commonly uses red, green and blue channels. Classification asks what an object is; localization asks where it is. Acquisition and resizing help establish input conditions. Audio is digitized into time-ordered values. Speech recognition turns sound into text; speech synthesis turns text into sound; speaker recognition estimates identity. Accent, speed and noise change the difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 图像是像素网格，彩色常用红绿蓝三通道。分类回答“是什么”，定位回答“在哪里”。采集与调整尺寸有助于统一输入条件。音频数字化后是按时间排列的数值。语音识别把声音转成文字，语音合成把文字转成声音，说话人识别判断身份。口音、语速和噪声都会影响难度。

paragraphs.en: Recommendation ranks what to show next using content and behavior, but a click can reflect curiosity or an accident and a missing click can mean no exposure. Optimizing clicks and broadening knowledge can yield different rankings. Prediction, planning and generation are other tasks. Competence in one task or condition does not establish competence elsewhere, human-like understanding or the ability to judge whether a request is appropriate.
paragraphs.zh: 推荐依据内容与行为排列展示顺序，但点击可能是好奇或误触，没点击也可能只是没看见。追求点击与拓展知识可能得到不同排序。数值预测、行动规划、内容生成也是任务。某一任务或条件下做得好，不证明其他情况也会做、不证明像人一样理解，也不证明能判断要求是否合理。

title.en: Start small, distinguish tested abilities from ambitions
title.zh: 从小尝试开始，区分已验证能力与愿景

paragraphs.en: CAICP’s book baseline uses E, J, S for foundational, introductory and advanced levels. Build understanding by writing small filters, drawing data, training simple models and inspecting their errors. A model is a computational method with adjustable numerical settings; large language models typically use many parameters, data and substantial computation. AGI is an ambition for broad, human-level learning and transfer, with contested definitions and tests. Success at one task does not prove reliable ability across all tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 本书基准以E,J,S表示基础、入门、进阶。写小筛选、画数据、训练简单模型并查看错误，逐步理解。模型是含可调整数值设置的计算方法，大语言模型通常参数多、数据多、计算大。AGI追求广泛人类水平学习迁移，其定义检验仍有争论。一个任务成功不证明所有任务可靠。

title.en: Sampling chooses when; quantization chooses precision
title.zh: 采样决定时刻，量化决定精度

paragraphs.en: Data represents observations, measurements or records; context turns a bare 25 into “25 °C at 9 am.” Units and recording granularity affect what questions can be answered. Analog representation varies continuously, such as microphone voltage; “analog” does not mean fake. Digital representation uses discrete values. Sampling measures at selected times; quantization assigns measured values to a finite set of levels.
paragraphs.zh: 数据表示观察、测量和记录。“25”需结合对象、时间、单位才能成为“上午九点25摄氏度”。单位与记录粒度决定可回答的问题。模拟表示用连续变化量，如麦克风电压；“模拟”不等于虚假。数字表示用离散值。采样在选定时刻测量，量化把测量归入有限档位。

paragraphs.en: A sensor sampled every ten minutes misses intermediate changes. Rounding 20.2 and 20.4 to integers loses their difference. More frequent sampling and finer levels retain detail at a storage/processing cost; smoothing cannot recover arbitrary lost information. Text, pictures and sound all become bits interpreted through encoding and file-format rules.
paragraphs.zh: 每十分钟采样会漏掉中间变化，把20.2和20.4取整会丢失差别。更密采样、更细档位保留更多细节，也需要更多存储与处理。画得平滑不能任意恢复丢失信息。文字、图像、声音都表示为位，再按编码与文件格式解释。

flow.en: Continuous signal → samples at selected times → discrete allowed levels → encoded bits
flow.zh: 连续信号→选定时刻的样本→离散允许档位→编码为位

title.en: Bits, bytes and raw image size
title.zh: 位、字节与原始图像大小

paragraphs.en: One bit has two values. b bits distinguish 2ᵇ combinations; 8 bits give 256 values, often 0–255, and form one byte (B). A 100×100 eight-bit grayscale image has 10, 000 pixel bytes. RGB with one byte per channel uses 30, 000 pixel bytes. Doubling width and height multiplies area and raw pixel data by four, not two.
paragraphs.zh: 一位有两种值，b位有2ᵇ种组合。8位有256种值，常为0–255，并组成一字节B。100×100的8位灰度图有10,000字节像素数据；RGB每通道一字节时为30,000字节。宽高都加倍，面积与原始像素数据变成四倍，不是两倍。

paragraphs.en: This is raw pixel data, not necessarily the actual file size: metadata, compression and channel precision also matter. Changing the filename extension does not change the encoded content.
paragraphs.zh: 这算的是原始像素，不一定是文件大小；元数据、压缩和通道精度还会影响结果。改变文件扩展名不会改变编码内容。

title.en: Three independent ways to classify data
title.zh: 描述数据的三个不同角度

paragraphs.en: A structured table has defined fields: each row is a sample, each column an attribute. For plants 001:(8.2 cm, 3.1 cm, A), 002:(5.6, 4.0, B), 003:(7.9, 2.8, A), leaf size can be features and species the label when predicting species. Changing the task can change these roles. An ID distinguishes records rather than expressing size or order of a biological property. Unlabeled data can still support unsupervised learning.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化表有明确字段，每行一个样本，每列一种属性。植物001:(8.2厘米,3.1厘米,甲)，002:(5.6,4.0,乙)，003:(7.9,2.8,甲)：预测种类时叶长叶宽为特征，种类为标签。任务变了，角色可能变。编号用于区分记录，不表示生物属性的大小或顺序。无标签数据仍可用于无监督学习。

paragraphs.en: Unstructured text, images and audio have internal organization but their meaning is not already expressed as fixed table fields. Sentiment extraction can turn wording into a categorical field. Modality describes form: text/image/audio; multimodal video needs time alignment. Digital/analog, structured/unstructured and single/multimodal are separate classifications: a digital photo can also be unstructured and image-modal.
paragraphs.zh: 非结构化文章、图像、音频并非毫无结构，只是含义未直接组织为固定字段；提取情感类别可增加结构化字段。模态描述文字、图像、音频等形式，多模态视频还需时间对齐。数字/模拟、结构化/非结构化、单/多模态是不同分类角度：数字照片可同时是非结构化图像数据。

title.en: Accuracy and representativeness are different
title.zh: 准确与代表性是两种要求

paragraphs.en: Check values, units, labels, completeness, duplication and coverage of deployment conditions. Many wrong labels do not become reliable because the dataset is large. Training cats only indoors and dogs only on grass can teach a background shortcut even when each label is correct. Add varied backgrounds, angles and lighting rather than more copies of the same conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 检查数值、单位、标签、完整性、重复与实际使用条件的覆盖。错误标签不会因为数量大就可靠。猫都在室内、狗都在草地，即使标签对，模型也可能学到背景捷径。应补充不同背景、角度、光照，而不只是增加同条件照片。

paragraphs.en: Accurate measurements from the sports team need not represent all pupils. Analyze both recording accuracy and how examples were selected.
paragraphs.zh: 校队记录可以很准确，却未必代表全校。记录是否准确与样本怎样选取都要检查。

title.en: An algorithm is a method; a program implements it
title.zh: 算法是方法，程序实现方法

paragraphs.en: Data supplies material, algorithms specify processing, and computing resources execute it. An algorithm needs definite steps and termination for its stated valid inputs. Natural language, flowcharts and pseudocode describe the method; executable code must obey a language’s syntax.
paragraphs.zh: 数据提供材料，算法规定处理，算力执行计算。算法对规定有效输入需要明确步骤并在有限步骤结束。自然语言、流程图与伪代码表达方法，程序还须符合语言语法。

paragraphs.en: For a nonempty sequence [17, 23, 19, 26], initialize the current maximum to 17; after comparisons it is 23, 23, 26. One scan solves the task without sorting. Faster hardware does not remove the value of avoiding unnecessary computation. Define empty-input behavior rather than indexing an empty list.
paragraphs.zh: 对非空序列[17,23,19,26]，当前最大值先为17，比较后依次23、23、26。一遍扫描即可，无需先排序。硬件快也值得省掉不必要计算。空输入必须先规定处理方式，不能直接取空列表首项。

flow.en: Initialize from first item → compare each remaining item → update if larger → return maximum
flow.zh: 用首项初始化→逐项比较→更大时更新→返回最大值

title.en: Follow data through the computer

paragraphs.en: CPU handles general computation and control; GPU has many units suited to parallel similar operations, including pixels and neural-network arithmetic. Not every task parallelizes well. Memory holds active code/data and is usually volatile; persistent storage retains files. Input devices acquire signals and output devices present results. Trained parameters held only in memory may be lost on power failure; explicitly saving a file is a separate operation.
paragraphs.zh: CPU负责通用计算与控制，GPU有大量适合并行相似运算的单元，如像素与神经网络计算。不是所有任务都适合并行。内存放运行中的代码与数据，通常断电丢失；持久存储保存文件。输入设备采集信号，输出设备呈现结果。训练参数只留在内存，断电可能丢失；保存文件是另一操作。

paragraphs.en: Capacity (B/MB/GB), clock frequency (GHz), arithmetic throughput (FLOPS/TOPS with conditions), bandwidth (data per time), and latency (time per operation) describe different quantities. A higher clock alone does not establish a faster end-to-end task. Throughput can be high while one request waits in a queue.
paragraphs.zh: 容量(B/MB/GB)、主频(GHz)、运算吞吐(FLOPS/TOPS，须注明条件)、带宽(每时间数据量)、延迟(每次操作时间)是不同量。主频高不能独自证明整个任务更快；吞吐高仍可能让单个请求排队。

title.en: Find the limiting step, not just the fastest chip
title.zh: 寻找瓶颈，不只比较芯片

paragraphs.en: An image pipeline taking 8 ms to read/transfer, 2 ms to compute and 1 ms to display totals 11 ms. Doubling compute speed changes 2 to 1 ms, so the total becomes 10 ms. The other 9 ms remain. Overlap between preparation and computation can improve batch throughput only where dependencies and resources permit.
paragraphs.zh: 读入传输8毫秒、计算2毫秒、显示1毫秒共11毫秒。只把计算加速一倍，2变1，总耗时仍是10毫秒，其他9毫秒没消失。准备与计算重叠可改善批量吞吐，但要满足依赖与资源条件。

paragraphs.en: A bottleneck may be reading, transfer, computation or queueing. Consider whether data fits memory and whether required operations are supported. CUDA is NVIDIA’s parallel platform/programming model; Ascend CANN (Compute Architecture for Neural Networks) supports heterogeneous AI computation. Frameworks, software and devices must work together; a label on hardware is not proof a model will run efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 瓶颈可能是读取、传输、计算或排队。还要检查能否放入内存、是否支持所需运算。CUDA是NVIDIA并行平台与编程模型，昇腾CANN(Compute Architecture for Neural Networks)支持异构AI计算。框架、软件、设备需配合，硬件名称不能保证模型高效运行。

paragraphs.en: Symbolic AI stores knowledge/rules and derives conclusions. “Sparrows are birds; birds are animals” implies sparrows are animals, but a false premise such as “all birds fly” fails on penguins even with valid reasoning. Maintaining broad knowledge with exceptions is difficult. Game search explores a branching tree and evaluates promising positions.
paragraphs.zh: 符号主义存知识与规则并推导结论。“麻雀是鸟，鸟是动物”推出麻雀是动物；但“所有鸟会飞”这个错误前提遇到企鹅即失败，即使推理步骤正确。广泛知识的例外难维护。棋局搜索探索分支树并评价有希望的局面。

paragraphs.en: Connectionism builds networks of simplified mathematical neurons. Rosenblatt’s late-1950s perceptron weights inputs and learns weights; its representational limits motivate multiple layers. Depth alone does not create intelligence: data, training and resources matter. Behavior-oriented systems are agents that observe and act in environments. Feedback-driven improvement of action policies is reinforcement learning; reactive rules alone need not learn. AlphaGo combines networks, search and reinforcement learning rather than fitting into only one school.

paragraphs.en: Generative AI creates text, images or other content. Plausible unsupported output is hallucination: a convincing book title, author and date may all be invented. paragraphs.en: The editor creates Python 3 source files, usually ending .py; the interpreter executes their statements. An expression computes a value. Comments begin with # outside a string and do not execute; line breaks and indentation matter.

title.en: Arithmetic, comparisons and short circuits

paragraphs.en: Python uses ** for powers, / for true division, // for floor division and % for remainder. 17=3×5+2; -17=(-4)×5+3, so -17//5 is -4 rather than int(-17/5), which is -3. += updates a numeric value. Comparisons ==,!=,<,>,<=,>= yield booleans; = assigns. Inclusive ages 10–15 need and (or the chained comparison), not or.

Parentheses clarify precedence: power, multiplicative, additive, comparison, not, and, or. -2**2 is -4; (-2)**2 is 4; 2**3**2 is 512. Zero, empty containers/text and None are false-like. and/or short-circuit and return an operand, not necessarily bool: count!=0 and total/count>10 safely skips zero division; "" or "Unnamed" returns the fallback string.

title.en: Trace branches and repeated steps

paragraphs.en: if/elif/else selects at most one branch; separate if statements evaluate independently. A colon introduces an indented block, conventionally four spaces per level. Nested conditions are reached only through their outer branch. Putting print outside versus inside a block changes when it runs.
paragraphs.zh: if/elif/else最多选一个分支，独立if各自判断。冒号引出缩进块，通常每级四空格，只有进入外层才执行内层。print在块内或块外决定执行时机。

paragraphs.en: for traverses an iterable such as a list or string. title.en: Index one element; slice a sequence

paragraphs.en: Sequences have positional order. Indexes start at zero; -1 is the last item. For "Python": [0]→P, [-1]→n, [1: 4]→yth, [: 3]→Pyt, [:: 2]→Pto, [::-1]→nohtyP. paragraphs.en: Quotes delimit strings; escapes such as \n and \\ represent newline and backslash. len(text) counts Unicode code points, which need not equal displayed symbols or stored bytes. paragraphs.en: Tuples are ordered and cannot replace/add/remove positions; a contained mutable list can still change. (3,) is a one-item tuple, (3) an integer; x, y=point unpacks two values. title.en: Recursion descends, then returns

paragraphs.en: For nonnegative integer n, total_to(0)=0 and total_to(n)=n+total_to(n-1). Calls for 3 wait on 2, then 1, then 0; returns unwind as 0, 1, 3, 6. Each call retains its own parameters and pending work. The base case and genuine progress toward it are both essential.

paragraphs.en: Passing a negative number or recursing with unchanged n does not reach zero. Python limits depth and can raise RecursionError. An iterative loop or sum(range(1, n+1)) solves this example too; recursion is an organizational tool, not a guarantee of speed.
paragraphs.zh: 负数或不变n不会到0，Python深度有限会报RecursionError。循环或sum(range(1,n+1))也能求解。递归是组织思路，不保证更快。

title.en: Claims, implications and counterexamples

paragraphs.en: Treat a proposition as a statement with a definite truth value. AND requires both claims; OR permits either or both; NOT reverses the truth value. Negation applies to the whole bracket: NOT(P AND Q) = (NOT P) OR (NOT Q); NOT(P OR Q) = (NOT P) AND (NOT Q).
paragraphs.zh: 命题是具有确定真值的陈述。AND 要求两者都真；OR 允许至少一个为真，包括两者都真；NOT 反转真值。否定作用于整个括号：非(P 且 Q)＝非P 或 非Q；非(P 或 Q)＝非P 且 非Q。

paragraphs.en: “If divisible by 4, then even” is an implication P ⇒ Q. Its converse Q ⇒ P fails at 6; its contrapositive NOT Q ⇒ NOT P is equivalent to the original. A valid syllogism chains implications, but a true conclusion still requires true premises. Negating “every picture is clear” gives “at least one picture is unclear”; negating “some pictures are labeled” gives “no pictures are labeled”. A single counterexample refutes a universal claim.
paragraphs.zh: “能被4整除则为偶数”是蕴含 P ⇒ Q。逆命题 Q ⇒ P 被6反驳；逆否命题 非Q ⇒ 非P 与原命题等价。有效三段论可连接蕴含，但要保证结论为真，前提也必须为真。“所有图片都清晰”的否定是“至少一张不清晰”；“存在有标签的图片”的否定是“没有图片有标签”。一个反例就能推翻全称判断。

title.en: Choose and read a chart

paragraphs.en: Bar charts compare category counts; line charts show ordered change; pie charts need nonoverlapping parts of the same whole; scatter plots compare paired numerical measurements. title.en: Errors must not cancel

paragraphs.en: Define error as prediction minus truth. MAE averages absolute errors; MSE averages squared errors. Four true values of 10 with predictions [8, 8, 12, 12] give MAE=2 and MSE=4; [10, 10, 10, 18] gives the same MAE=2 but MSE=16. Squaring penalizes a large individual error more strongly. If the allowed maximum error is 4, the first model satisfies it and the second does not. MAE has the target’s units, while MSE has squared units; comparing their numerical magnitudes directly is meaningless.
paragraphs.zh: 误差定义为预测减真实值。MAE平均绝对误差；MSE平均平方误差。四个真实值都为10，预测[8,8,12,12]得MAE=2、MSE=4；预测[10,10,10,18]同样MAE=2，却MSE=16。平方更重惩罚单个大误差。若允许的最大误差为4，前者满足，后者不满足。MAE单位与目标相同，MSE单位平方，不能直接比较两者数值大小。

title.en: Translate a situation into symbols

paragraphs.en: A 2 MB file plus 5 MB fixed overhead gives y=2x+5, where file count x is a nonnegative integer. Separate variables, constants, coefficients and parameters: a trained model’s coefficient is fixed while predicting but can change during training. A subscript xᵢ identifies a sample; x² is a square. Σ means sum; x̄ is a mean; ŷ marks a prediction. Sum of squares 1²+3²=10 differs from (1+3)²=16. For truths [2, 4, 6] and predictions [3, 4, 4], MSE=(1+0+4)/3=5/3, retaining even the zero-error sample in n.

title.en: Powers, roots and quadratics

paragraphs.en: Use exponent rules only with their domain conditions; nonzero a has a⁰=1 and a⁻ⁿ=1/aⁿ. Combine like polynomial terms and use the highest nonzero degree. x²=9 has solutions ±3, but √9 is the principal root 3; √2 is an irrational real number, approximately 1.414. x²=−1 has no real solution.
paragraphs.zh: 指数法则需满足定义域条件；a非零时a⁰=1、a⁻ⁿ=1/aⁿ。多项式合并同类项，以最高非零项确定次数。x²=9有±3两个解，√9却是算术平方根3；√2是约1.414的无理实数。x²=−1没有实数解。

paragraphs.en: For ax²+bx+c=0 with a≠0, the roots are (−b±√(b²−4ac))/(2a). The discriminant D=b²−4ac gives two real roots for D>0, one repeated root for D=0 and none for D<0. Factor x²−5x+6=(x−2)(x−3) to find 2 and 3. A domain restriction x>2 retains only 3. Do not cancel an expression that might be zero without treating that case.

title.en: Functions and coordinate graphs

paragraphs.en: A mathematical function assigns one output to each allowed input; different inputs can share an output, as (−2)²=2²=4. This is different from a Python function, which may print or change data. For y=kx+b, equal input increases give output increases k times as large; k=0 is constant. Quadratic increments are not constant. For 2ˣ at x=1, 2, 3, 4 the values are 2, 4, 8, 16; 2⁰=1 and 2⁻²=1/4. e≈2.71828; ln is the inverse of eˣ on positive inputs, with ln(1)=0 and ln(e)=1.
paragraphs.zh: 数学函数给每个允许输入唯一输出；不同输入可同输出，如(−2)²=2²=4。这不同于可能打印或修改数据的Python函数。y=kx+b中，相同输入增量带来k倍输出增量；k=0为常函数。二次函数增量不固定。2ˣ在x=1,2,3,4时为2,4,8,16；2⁰=1、2⁻²=1/4。e约2.71828；ln在正数上是eˣ的反函数，ln(1)=0、ln(e)=1。

paragraphs.en: Coordinates are ordered (x, y); the origin, positive directions and units matter. Quadrants start upper right and go counterclockwise; axis points lie in no quadrant. Points (−2, 4),(−1, 1),(0, 0),(1, 1),(2, 4) sample y=x², not its entire continuous graph. Positive quadratic coefficient opens upward. Intersections with y=4 solve x²=4; intersections of x²−4 with the x-axis solve the same equation. For a line through (1, 3),(3, 7), slope=(7−3)/(3−1)=2. Changing b from 1 to −2 shifts a line down 3; changing k changes slope while retaining the intercept. Plot scaling changes visual steepness, not coordinate slope.
paragraphs.zh: 坐标是有序(x,y)，需确定原点、正方向和单位。象限从右上逆时针编号，轴上点不属任何象限。(−2,4)、(−1,1)、(0,0)、(1,1)、(2,4)只是y=x²上的样本点，不是整个连续图像。二次项系数为正则开口向上。与y=4交点解x²=4；x²−4与x轴交点解同一方程。过(1,3)、(3,7)的直线斜率=(7−3)/(3−1)=2。b从1改−2整线下移3；改变k会改变斜率而保留截距。绘图比例改变视觉陡峭程度，不改变坐标斜率。

title.en: Vectors describe features and movement

paragraphs.en: A feature space may have three or many dimensions; its axes need not be physical directions. Euclidean distance from (1, 2) to (4, 6) is √(3²+4²)=5; between (1, 2, 3) and (3, 3, 5) it is √(2²+1²+2²)=3. Match feature meanings and units before comparing distances: an arbitrary unit change can dominate a neighbor search.
paragraphs.zh: 特征空间可有三维或更多维，坐标轴不必对应物理方向。(1,2)到(4,6)的欧氏距离为√(3²+4²)=5；(1,2,3)到(3,3,5)为√(2²+1²+2²)=3。先统一特征含义和单位；随意换单位可能主导邻居查找。

paragraphs.en: A vector is an ordered sequence with a dimension. As an arrow it represents displacement and can be relocated without changing direction or length; a point represents a position. For u=(3, 1), v=(1, 2), u+v=(4, 3), u−v=(2,−1), 2u=(6, 2); a negative scalar reverses direction. The dot product (2, 1)·(3, 4)=10, and ‖(3, 4)‖=5 because its self-dot-product is 25. Distance is the norm of a difference, not the dot product of the two positions. Equal dimensions alone do not guarantee meaningful feature alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 向量是有维数的有序序列。作为箭头表示位移，平移后方向和长度不变；点表示位置。u=(3,1)、v=(1,2)，则u+v=(4,3)、u−v=(2,−1)、2u=(6,2)；负倍数反向。点积(2,1)·(3,4)=10，‖(3,4)‖=5，因为自点积为25。距离是差向量的范数，不是两个位置的点积。维数相等不保证特征顺序有意义。

title.en: Probability, frequency and event rules

paragraphs.en: The sample space Ω lists outcomes; an event is a subset. Probability lies from 0 to 1. Count favorable outcomes only when basic outcomes are equally likely: a fair die has even probability 3/6, but a bag of 9 red and 1 blue balls has red probability 9/10, not 1/2 because there are two colors. Twelve heads in 20 trials is observed frequency 0.6, not proof that a fair coin’s probability changed. Large-sample stabilization is not monotonic or a promise of forced balancing.
paragraphs.zh: 样本空间Ω列出基本结果，事件是其子集。概率在0到1之间。只有基本结果等可能时才可数有利结果：公平骰子偶数概率3/6；9红1蓝的袋子抽红概率9/10，不能因颜色两种而写1/2。20次出现12次正面是频率0.6，不证明公平硬币概率改变。大样本趋稳不是单调过程，也不强迫次数自动平衡。

paragraphs.en: P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B), P(not A)=1−P(A). Mutually exclusive events cannot happen together; independent events do not change each other’s probability. Die results 1 and 2 are exclusive but not independent; heads on two independent flips coincide with probability 1/4. Drawing from 2 red and 1 blue without replacement makes the second red probability 1/2 after a red, compared with initial 2/3. Replacement and mixing can restore independence under the stated assumptions. Three independent chances with success probability .2 give at least one success 1−.8³=.488 and exactly one 3×.2×.8²=.384.
paragraphs.zh: P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B)，P(非A)=1−P(A)。互斥指不能同时发生，独立指不改变彼此概率。骰子点数1与2互斥却不独立；两次独立抛币都正面概率1/4。2红1蓝不放回抽取，已抽红后下一次红概率1/2，初始为2/3。放回并混匀在题设条件下可恢复独立。三次独立机会成功率.2，至少一次成功1−.8³=.488，恰一次3×.2×.8²=.384。

title.en: Random variables and distributions

paragraphs.en: A random variable assigns a numerical value to an outcome. Discrete values are finite or countable; a fair die assigns 1/6 to each of six values. Continuous uniform time from 0 to 10 has interval probability P(2≤X≤5)=3/10; an individual point has probability zero, which does not make that observed time impossible.

paragraphs.en: A binomial count needs fixed n, two outcomes per trial, independent trials and unchanged success probability p. P(X=k)=C(n, k)pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ, with C(n, k)=n!/[k!(n−k)!], 0!=1. Three fair flips have head-count probabilities [1, 3, 3, 1]/8: eight equiprobable sequences, not four equiprobable counts. For p=0 all counts are zero; p=1 all equal n. Sampling without replacement is generally not binomial.

title.en: Encoding needs agreed boundaries

paragraphs.en: Assign circle=00, triangle=01, square=10, star=11. Circle–square–triangle becomes 001001; split into 00, 10, 01 to decode. Two bits support 2²=4 symbols, insufficient for five. title.en: Maintain the candidate interval

paragraphs.en: Linear search needs no sorting and returns the first matching index; -1 means absent, but in Python indexing −1 means the last item, so check the marker before indexing. Binary search requires ascending order. With inclusive endpoints, compute middle=(left+right)//2; after comparing, use middle+1 or middle−1 to exclude the checked position. Stop at left>right. Empty input returns −1 immediately; duplicates may return any matching occurrence, not necessarily the first.
paragraphs.zh: 顺序查找不要求排序，返回第一次匹配的位置；−1表示不存在，但Python下标−1会取最后一项，必须先判断标记。二分要求升序。使用包含端点的区间，middle=(left+right)//2，比较后用middle+1或middle−1排除已检查位置，left>right停止。空输入直接−1，重复值可能返回任一次，不保证第一处。

paragraphs.en: For [2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 20], target 14 checks indices 3 (11), 5 (17), 4 (14), returning 4. Target 13 follows the same first two steps then excludes 14 to reach left=4, right=3. The invariant is: if the target exists, it remains inside the candidate interval. To find a first occurrence, equality cannot always end the search; preserve the unresolved left side.

title.en: Compare the whole process

paragraphs.en: Worst-case linear search grows as O(n); repeated halving grows as O(log n). Doubling 16 to 32 adds roughly one binary-search comparison. Two loops each running n times can produce O(n²) work. Big-O describes growth, not exact seconds; hardware and load affect timing. Space use also matters: a few endpoints differ from copying all records. Sorting for one query may cost more than a linear scan; repeated queries can justify preprocessing.

title.en: Three different sorted regions

paragraphs.en: For [4, 1, 3, 2], one bubble pass compares adjacent items and leaves [1, 3, 2, 4]: only the final maximum is guaranteed. Selection chooses the minimum of the remaining suffix and swaps it into the first unresolved position. Insertion keeps a sorted prefix and shifts larger elements right to insert the next item. When inserting 3 into [1, 4, 3, 2], the list temporarily becomes [1, 4, 4, 2]; 3 survives in a temporary variable, then fills position j+1.

paragraphs.en: Stability preserves the original order of equal keys. Strict > in bubble and insertion avoids moving equal items past one another. Selection swaps [2A, 2B, 1] to [1, 2B, 2A], so this implementation is unstable. Python sorted returns a new list; list.sort changes the original; both are stable. Copying at a function’s start preserves the caller’s list. Bubble’s no-swap flag permits an early stop; selection’s smallest variable stores an index, not a value. All three have O(n²) worst-case work.

title.en: BFS discovers the nearest layer first

paragraphs.en: A FIFO queue processes nearer layers first. Mark a node when enqueuing, not after removing it, to avoid duplicate queue entries. For the book graph S:[A, B], A:[S, C, D], B:[S, D], C:[A, T], D:[A, B, T], T:[C, D], BFS visits S, A, B, C, D, T and gives distance(T)=3. Discovering a neighbor sets distance=parent distance+1. title.en: Use the current error each step

paragraphs.en: Feedback measures an output and uses it to choose the next action. A thermostat comparing temperature to its target is a closed loop; a fixed-time heater without measurement is open loop. title.en: The target defines the task

paragraphs.en: A sample is one record, image or recording; features describe it; the target is what the model should predict. The same plant table supports classification (species), regression (area) or clustering (similar groups without supplied target categories). Binary and multiclass labels identify categories; numerical label 1 is not quantitatively greater than label 0. Predicting a class number is classification; predicting an integer visitor count can be regression, with rounding and nonnegative constraints afterward.

paragraphs.en: Clusters do not automatically equal species: growth stages can split one species, while similar features can merge different species. Equal length and width can still correspond to different leaf shapes and areas; information omitted from the features limits any model.

title.en: Where do learning targets come from?

paragraphs.en: Supervised learning uses target answers from annotation, measurements or existing records; it does not require a person beside every calculation. Classification and regression are typical. Unsupervised learning seeks structure without these target labels; clustering is one example, not its entire definition. A task and similarity rule are still needed.
paragraphs.zh: 监督学习使用人工标注、测量或已有记录的目标答案，不要求每次计算旁边有人；分类和回归是典型任务。非监督学习无此类目标标签而寻找结构，聚类只是其中一种，仍需规定任务与相似规则。

paragraphs.en: Semi-supervised learning combines a small labeled set with a larger unlabeled set. Pseudo-labeling can help but can amplify confident mistakes. Self-supervised learning constructs targets from the data itself, such as predicting a masked part of an existing sentence. It differs from semi-supervised learning in how targets originate, not merely the number of human labels.

title.en: Train, validate and test have different jobs

paragraphs.en: Training learns parameters; validation chooses settings; testing evaluates the final choice independently. 600/200/200 from 1000 independent comparable records is an example, not a required ratio. paragraphs.en: Training targets [2, 4, 6] give constant-mean baseline 4. On validation truths [3, 4, 8], its MAE=5/3, MSE=17/3. title.en: Weighted sums are predictions, not laws
title.zh: 加权和是预测，不是自然定律

paragraphs.en: ŷ=wx+b gives9 at x=4 for w=2, b=1. With two features, weights2, 3, bias 1 and input(4, 2) give15. Negative weights reduce the prediction when that feature increases, holding others fixed in this model; correlated features and data choices prevent a causal conclusion. Input units determine the weight’s meaning.
paragraphs.zh: ŷ=wx+b，w=2、b=1、x=4时得9。两特征权重2、3、偏置1、输入(4,2)得15。负权重表示本模型中其他特征固定时该项增加使预测减少，相关特征和数据选择不支持因果推断。输入单位决定权重含义。

paragraphs.en: Least squares minimizes squared output errors at the same input, not shortest geometric distances to a line. MSE L=Σ(wxᵢ+b−yᵢ)²/n fixes the data and varies shared parameters. Dividing by fixed n does not change the minimizer. A constant predictor for targets2, 4, 6 minimizes3(b−4)²+8 at mean b=4, without passing through every target.
paragraphs.zh: 最小二乘最小化同输入处的输出平方差，不是点到线最短几何距离。MSE L=Σ(wxᵢ+b−yᵢ)²/n固定数据，改变共同参数，除固定n不改变最优参数。目标2,4,6的常数预测器最小化3(b−4)²+8，取均值b=4，不需经过每个目标。

title.en: Neighbors vote only after distance and K are defined

paragraphs.en: Decision score g=2x₁−x₂−1 labels A at g≥0, B otherwise; g=0 is the boundary, not a probability. A decision function predicts; a loss function evaluates mismatch during training.
paragraphs.zh: 分数g=2x₁−x₂−1在g≥0判甲，否则乙；g=0是边界，不是概率。决策函数给预测，损失函数在训练中评价偏差。

paragraphs.en: KNN keeps training samples and chooses K nearest by distance. Classification votes; regression averages targets. For q=(2, 2) and A(1, 1), A(2, 1), B(4, 4), distances√2, 1,√8 give A for K1 or3. At q=(3, 3), nearby B(3.2, 3) and A(2, 3), A(3, 2) give B for K1 but A for K3. Sorting squared distances preserves order and avoids square roots. K is a hyperparameter between1 and sample count; define tied distances and votes. Small K is sensitive to unusual points, large K can drown local structure; validation, feature scales and meaningful features matter.
paragraphs.zh: KNN保留训练样本，按距离选K个邻居；分类投票，回归平均目标。q=(2,2)与甲(1,1)、甲(2,1)、乙(4,4)距离√2、1、√8，K1或3都甲。q=(3,3)附近乙(3.2,3)、甲(2,3)、甲(3,2)，K1判乙、K3判甲。平方距离排序保持顺序，可省开方。K为1到样本数的超参数，需规定距离和票数并列规则。小K受异常点影响，大K可能淹没局部结构，需验证并考虑尺度与特征意义。

paragraphs.en: A decision tree’s root and internal nodes test conditions; leaves output classes or proportions. Gini impurity=1−Σpⱼ² is .5 for equal binary classes, 0 for a pure node. Entropy is another measure of mixture. Compare child impurities weighted by sample counts.
paragraphs.zh: 树的根和内部节点检验条件，叶子输出类别或比例。基尼不纯度1−Σpⱼ²，两类各半为.5，纯节点为0；熵也是混杂指标，子节点需按样本数加权。

paragraphs.en: Lengths1…6 with labels A, A, B, B, B, A start at Gini .5. Threshold2.5 gives left2 pure A and right3B+1A, weighted impurity(2/6)×0+(4/6)×3/8=1/4. title.en: A margin is constrained by nearby samples

paragraphs.en: A basic linear SVM seeks a separating line, plane or hyperplane with a large minimum margin. Nearby critical points are support vectors. A at(1, 1),(1, 3) and B at(3, 1),(3, 3): boundary x₁=1.5 leaves minimum distance .5, while x₁=2 leaves1 on each side. Extra A(0, 2), B(4, 2) are farther and do not tighten this symmetric margin.
paragraphs.zh: 基本线性SVM寻找最小间隔较大的分界线、平面或超平面，附近关键点是支持向量。甲(1,1),(1,3)、乙(3,1),(3,3)，边界x₁=1.5最小距.5，x₁=2两侧各1。追加甲(0,2)、乙(4,2)更远，不进一步收紧该对称间隔。

paragraphs.en: Overlapping data may need a soft margin permitting penalized violations. Larger C emphasizes avoiding violations; smaller C tolerates more, under otherwise equal settings. Neither is always better. A kernel represents richer similarities and curved original-space boundaries; it is not a label rule or convolution kernel. Choose models by data, representation, explanation needs and validation, not novelty.
paragraphs.zh: 重叠数据可用允许惩罚违规的软间隔，其他相同时大C更强调避免违规、小C更容许，不是越大越好。核表达更丰富相似性和原空间曲线边界，不是标签规则或卷积核。按数据、表示、解释需求和验证选模型，不按新旧。

title.en: Fix the observations, vary the parameter

paragraphs.en: Statistical inference estimates an unknown population or process using samples and assumptions. With independent flips and fixed unknown head probability p, sequence H, H, H, T has likelihood L(p)=p³(1−p). At p=.25,.5,.75,.9 it gives .0117,.0625,.1055,.0729 approximately. It is maximized at observed proportion3/4; at0 or1 it is zero because the sequence contains both outcomes.

paragraphs.en: Likelihood is a function of parameters for fixed data, not a probability distribution over parameters. Counting three heads without order adds factor4, unchanged in p, so the maximizer stays the same. Four heads give estimate1 but do not prove tails impossible. Logarithms turn positive products into sums and preserve the maximizer. Least squares matches a maximum-likelihood solution under independent, equal-variance, zero-mean normal errors; this is conditional on that error model. A grid search only proves the best tested candidate.

title.en: Update a prior with the evidence

paragraphs.en: Bayes: P(A|B)=P(B|A)P(A)/P(B), with P(B)>0. Prior P(A) precedes evidence; posterior follows it; the denominator normalizes. With20% cats, sensitivity90%, false-positive rate10%, a cat report has probability .9×.2+.1×.8=.26 and actual-cat posterior .18/.26≈69.2%. Reliable inference needs probabilities valid for the new population.

paragraphs.en: Two equally likely coins have head rates .5 and .75. Observe heads: posterior biased-coin probability=.375/.625=.6. Another head updates to .45/.65=9/13. title.en: Count epochs and updates separately

paragraphs.en: Batch gradient descent uses all samples; stochastic training can use one; minibatches use a small group. title.en: Local windows reuse learned weights
title.zh: 局部窗口复用学习到的权重

paragraphs.en: A CNN respects local pixel structure using sliding kernels. For X=[[1, 2, 0],[0, 1, 3],[2, 1, 0]], K=[[1, 0],[0,−1]], bias 0, stride 1, no padding, windows give[[0,−1],[−1, 1]]. Multiply matching entries, sum, add bias. Reusing one kernel at each position is weight sharing; learned kernels can respond to edges or textures, without every map necessarily naming a body part.
paragraphs.zh: CNN用滑动核利用局部像素结构。X=[[1,2,0],[0,1,3],[2,1,0]]、K=[[1,0],[0,−1]]、偏置0、步幅1、无填充，输出[[0,−1],[−1,1]]，对应相乘求和再加偏置。同核各位置复用是权重共享，学习核可响应边缘纹理，但不能机械给每图命名部件。

paragraphs.en: The book follows deep-learning cross-correlation (no kernel flip), often called convolution; strict mathematical convolution flips the kernel and can give different numbers. For ordinary contiguous kernels, output length=floor((n+2p−k)/s)+1 when at least one window fits. n3, k2, p0, s1 gives2; 5×5 with3×3, stride 1, padding 1 stays5×5. Stride moves the window; padding adds edge values. Several RGB channels are summed per kernel: 3×3×3 weights+bias=28; 4 kernels have112 parameters and4 output channels.
paragraphs.zh: 书中采用不翻核的深度学习互相关，常称卷积；严格数学卷积会翻核，数字可不同。普通连续核且能放至少一窗时，长度floor((n+2p−k)/s)+1。n3,k2,p0,s1得2；5×5配3×3、步1、填1仍5×5。步幅移动窗口，填充加边值。RGB跨通道相加，一个核3×3×3权重加偏置=28，四核112参数、四输出通道。

paragraphs.en: Input8×8×3 →4 kernels3×3, stride 1, no padding →6×6×4 →ReLU(same) →pool2×2, stride 2 →3×3×4 →flatten36 →dense3 →Softmax3. Convolution has(3×3×3+1)×4=112 parameters; dense has(36+1)×3=111; total223. ReLU, pooling, flatten and Softmax add no trainable parameters in this network.

paragraphs.en: The convolution produces144 values using shared112 parameters. Independently connecting144 outputs to all192 input values would need(192+1)×144=27, 792 parameters. Fewer parameters explain structural efficiency, not universal superiority. Occlusion, light and position changes still need task-specific data and evaluation. Output three scores become mutually exclusive probability estimates only with the appropriate Softmax and training.

answer.zh: 合成为另一个仿射映射，需非线性。

answer.zh: 不，查过拟合、划分分布，考虑早停。

paragraphs.en: A token can be a character, word, word-piece, punctuation or other symbol—not always one Chinese character or English word. IDs become embedding vectors. paragraphs.en: Attention computes query-dependent relevance and weighted information. Query says what to match, keys enable comparisons, values provide the aggregated content. title.en: Compute one attention head by hand

paragraphs.en: Fixed weights .75,.25 on values(2, 0),(0, 4) give(1.5, 1). To derive weights, use q=(1, 0), keys(2, 0),(0, 2), values(2, 0),(0, 4). Dot scores2, 0 divided by√2 become≈1.414, 0. title.en: Separate laws, policy and voluntary frameworks
title.zh: 区分法律、政策与自愿框架

paragraphs.en: Book v0.9’s governance examples are versioned reference material: China’s2023 interim generative-AI service measures combine development and risk management within their stated scope, including personal-information and annotation protections; the EU’s2024 AI Act uses risk-based obligations for specified uses, including transparency and oversight; NIST AI RMF1.0(2023) is voluntary, organized around Govern, Map, Measure, Manage. Their legal nature, covered actors and staged effective provisions differ. Consult the then-effective text for an actual case, not a country-wide slogan.
paragraphs.zh: v0.9治理案例是版本化参考：2023中国生成式AI服务暂行办法在规定范围结合发展与风险，涉及个人信息和标注保护；2024欧盟AI法案按风险规定特定用途义务，涉及透明监督；NIST AI RMF1.0（2023）为自愿框架，以治理、识别情境、测量、管理组织。法律性质、适用主体和分阶段条款不同，真实案例需查当时有效文本，不能概括一国全部态度。

paragraphs.en: Responsibility belongs to people and organizations designing, deploying, managing and using systems in context. Meaningful human review requires information and power to change or stop an action, not a decorative confirmation button. Campus safety versus privacy calls for necessary purpose, minimal collection, appropriate zones, access, retention and dispute handling. AI tutoring should return to the learner’s own reasoning: explain steps, change inputs and verify evidence; copying a result is not understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 责任需按情境分析开发部署管理使用的人与组织。有效人工复核需信息及改变停止能力，不是象征按钮。校园安全与隐私需讨论必要目的、少收集、区域、访问、留存和争议处理。AI辅导应接回自己的推理：解释步骤、换输入、核证据，复制结果不是理解。

title.en: Chapter retrieval workshop

paragraphs.en: Cover the explanations and answer these book-inspired prompts aloud. Then reveal the reasoning. This workshop does not change lesson completion or quiz scores.
paragraphs.zh: 遮住解释，口头回答这些按教材改编的问题，再展开推理。本工作坊不改变完成状态或测验成绩。

prompt.en: In “the robot lifts the cup and places it”, why does context matter?
prompt.zh: “机器人拿杯子把它放下”何需上下文？

answer.en: “It” needs the preceding objects and relations to identify its referent.
answer.zh: “它”需前文对象关系来确定指代。

prompt.en: How to verify a fluent book description?
prompt.zh: 如何核验流畅书籍介绍？

answer.en: Find independent original records of title, author and publication; detail is not proof.
answer.zh: 查独立原始书名作者出版记录，细节不是证明。

prompt.en: An agent plans reading and plotting but produces neither. Completed?
prompt.zh: 智能体计划读文件画图却没产生，完成吗？

answer.en: No. Inspect actual inputs, execution and outputs.
answer.zh: 未完成，查真实输入运行输出。

prompt.en: A simulated route works but wheels slip. Why observe after moving?
prompt.zh: 模拟路线可行却轮滑，何需移动后观察？

answer.en: Prediction has model assumptions; feedback detects real deviations and guides corrections.
answer.zh: 预测有模型假设，反馈发现真实偏差并修正。

prompt.en: Should failed fertilizer predictions be deleted?
prompt.zh: 肥料预测未被实验支持，应删记录吗？

answer.en: No. Check conditions, measurement and model hypotheses using the conflicting evidence.
answer.zh: 不，用冲突证据查条件测量模型假设。

prompt.en: Dialect users fail a music request service while most succeed. What should be reported?
prompt.zh: 方言点歌常失败多数成功，应报何？

answer.en: Group errors and conditions, not only a class-wide average; retain alternative access.
answer.zh: 分组错误条件，不只全班平均，并保留替代入口。

studyGuide.zh: 用自己的话解释概念，区分相近概念。

studyGuide.en: Cover worked results, then independently calculate and trace code.
studyGuide.zh: 遮住例题结果，独立计算并追踪代码。

studyGuide.en: Change a condition—unsort a search table, remove replacement, change units—and explain which steps fail.
studyGuide.zh: 改变条件：打乱查找表、不放回、改单位，解释何步骤失效。

studyGuide.en: Master: independently perform; understand: explain logic; adapt: transfer with hints; recognize: identify with cues.
studyGuide.zh: 掌握：独立完成；理解：解释逻辑；仿用：提示下迁移；识别：提示下辨认。

studyGuide.en: Record “can explain / can calculate / need hints / still unsure” rather than treating a forgotten fact as total inability.
studyGuide.zh: 记录“会讲／会算／需提示／仍疑问”，不把忘一事实当全不会。

studyGuide.en: Use papers after building the relevant foundations. For mistakes, return to concepts, units, row/column directions, boundaries and execution order.
studyGuide.zh: 形成相关基础后使用模拟卷，错后回到概念、单位、行列、边界与执行顺序。
